source.title: Clostridioides difficile-induced diarrhoea following dasatinib therapy

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors report a case of Clostridioides difficile infection arising during dasatinib therapy and frame it as a possible dasatinib-associated complication.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Chemotherapeutic agents, such as dasatinib, should be considered as possible etiological agents in the pathogenesis of CDI, even in absence of antibiotic use.
